senses.sense_definition: An alternative spelling of <w>appley</w>, meaning resembling or tasting of apples.

examples.text: The cider had a distinct, <w>apply</w> aroma that reminded him of autumn.

target_lang_translations.pl: Cydr miał wyraźny, <w>jabłkowy</w> aromat, który przypominał mu jesień.
target_lang_translations.de: Der Cidre hatte ein ausgeprägtes, <w>apfelartiges</w> Aroma, das ihn an den Herbst erinnerte.

target_lang_translations.zh: 这种苹果酒有一种独特的<w>苹果味</w>，让他想起了秋天。

examples.text: She described the dessert as having a pleasantly <w>apply</w> flavor.
